name: Stonegear's Search
summary: At Steelgrill's Depot, Pilot Stonegear seeks a rare ore for his tank. He asks a daring traveler to find fresh fuel for its weapons.

sections.title: A Tinkerer's Ambition
sections.body: Pilot Stonegear, stationed just outside Ironforge, wants to make his siege engine more powerful. Word of his plans spreads through Ironforge and Loch Modan. Pilot Longbeard or Mountaineer Kadrell may send you to meet the ambitious pilot and hear his proposal.

sections.title: Heading to Steelgrill's Depot
sections.body: Pilot Stonegear works at Steelgrill's Depot, a proving ground and staging yard along the road just east of Kharanos. He seeks prospectors willing to search for a rare, volatile ore. He believes it can greatly increase his tank's firepower.

faq.answer: Pilot Longbeard in Ironforge or Mountaineer Kadrell along the road in Loch Modan can direct you to Pilot Stonegear.

faq.q: Where can I find Pilot Stonegear?
faq.answer: Pilot Stonegear is at Steelgrill's Depot in Dun Morogh, just down the path northeast of Kharanos.
Pilot Stonegear enjoys modifying his siege engine and seeks rare mineral deposits to increase the firepower of his tank's munitions.
After you report to Pilot Stonegear at the depot, he sends you to find Incendicite, a volatile ore in the wetlands.
Yes. Pilot Stonegear and his contacts serve Ironforge's military and the Alliance.

faq.q: Why is the depot interested in wild ores?
faq.answer: Dwarven engineers and tank pilots experiment with incendiary compounds, pyrotechnics, and volatile elements to give their war machines an edge against troggs, dark irons, and wild beasts.

angles.text: As a dwarven mountaineer or mechanist, you can take pride in helping a fellow pilot at Steelgrill's Depot refine Khaz Modan's arsenal.
As a gnomish innovator, you can appreciate Pilot Stonegear's drive to push siege weapons beyond standard safety limits.
As a miner who seeks exotic, combustible earth, you may find Stonegear's rumors of rare underground ore worth pursuing.
As an engineer who works with high explosives, you can respect Stonegear's dedication to increasing his tank's firepower.
